items.title: Wedbush Revises Best Ideas List After October Underperformance

items.title: Aimbridge Hospitality Selected to Manage Seattle Marriott Redmond
items.summary: PLANO, Texas, November 06, 2026--Aimbridge Hospitality has been selected to manage the Seattle Marriott Redmond. The company will assume management of the hotel in January 2027.
